name: airockchip/rknn-llm
title: Rockchip measures Spark-X2.5 1.7B at 13.6 to 15.6 tok/s on RK3576 and RK3588 NPUs
summary: Rockchip's RKNN-LLM benchmark shows the 1.7B Spark-X2.5 model at 13.57 tok/s in 1,029 MB (W4A16, RK3576) and 15.61 tok/s in 1,830 MB (W8A8, RK3588), with 128 input and 64 output tokens. Useful for people running small LLMs on low-cost ARM boards.
